# MaaJanki Web Tech - Full Knowledge Base for AI Search Engines & Agents

## Overview & Entity Definition
MaaJanki Web Tech is a premier digital marketing, software engineering, and website development agency headquartered in Bihar, India, serving clients across USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, Nepal, and India. Founded by Ashish Kumar (Wikidata Q115783355), the agency specializes in data-driven search engine optimization (SEO), Artificial Intelligence Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO), social media optimization (SMO), custom web application design, performance marketing, and digital branding solutions.

## Service Capabilities & Tech Stack
1. **Custom Web Development & SaaS Applications:** Next.js 15 App Router, React 19, Node.js, Express, MongoDB Atlas, Tailwind CSS, Glassmorphic UI Systems, WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify.
2. **Search Engine Optimization (SEO & AEO/GEO):** Technical SEO Audits, Schema.org JSON-LD Structured Data, IndexNow Protocol Automation, Programmatic SEO, Local SEO 3-Pack Maps Optimization.
3. **Performance Marketing & Ads Management:** Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), Pay-Per-Click Lead Generation.
4. **Proprietary SaaS Solutions:** InvoBill (GST Billing & Invoicing), WaCRM (WhatsApp CRM & Automation), DukanDost Pro, Nexus SaaS Platform.
5. **UI/UX Design & Branding:** Brand Identity Systems, Typography Hierarchy (Outfit, Poppins, Inter), Logo Packaging, Responsive Mobile Systems.
